jobs.title: F&B Service Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Operations & Standards

- Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices.

- Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels.

- Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards.

- Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence.

Guest Experience & Quality Assurance

- Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements.

- Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering.

- Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs.

Training & Leadership Development

- Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy.

- Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel.

- Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet.

- Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership.

- Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required.

Financial Oversight

- Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet.

- Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems.

- Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards.

- Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative.

- Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

L'F&B Service Manager è un ruolo strategico di base responsabile per la gestione, la supervisione e la guida di tutte le operazioni di servizio Food & Beverage in tutta la flotta. Questo ruolo garantisce l'eccellenza del servizio, la coerenza nell'esperienza degli ospiti e l'allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Essendo il principale collegamento tra i team di bordo e la leadership aziendale, il Manager di F&B Service guida qualità, innovazione, conformità e sviluppo di talenti in tutte le operazioni F&B. Questo ruolo riporta direttamente al Vice Presidente della F&B.

Il tuo impatto

Operazioni e standard strategici

- Definire, implementare e mantenere standard di servizio F&B a livello di flotta e best practice.

- Sviluppare e supervisionare iniziative strategiche per migliorare l'esperienza degli ospiti e l'efficienza operativa in tutte le navi.

- Coordinare i team di bordo per garantire il rispetto delle politiche aziendali, delle procedure e degli standard di marca.

- Condurre audit remoti, recensioni operative e valutazioni per mantenere l'eccellenza dei servizi.

Esperienza e garanzia di qualità

- Monitorare la soddisfazione degli ospiti e le metriche delle prestazioni F&B, analizzare le tendenze e raccomandare miglioramenti.

- Collabora con i team culinari e bevande per innovare ed elevare l'offerta F&B a bordo.

- Assicurare l'allineamento con i protocolli di salute, sicurezza e igiene globali attraverso i programmi aziendali.

Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership

- Progettare e supervisionare i programmi di formazione per i team F&B per garantire la coerenza con la filosofia di servizio del marchio.

- Mentor e sviluppare i leader di bordo F&B per sostenere la progressione di carriera e la pianificazione di successione.

Risorse umane e supervisione della leadership

- Collaborare con le risorse umane su recensioni, promozioni, rotazioni e percorsi di carriera per il personale F&B.

- Promuovere una cultura ad alte prestazioni radicata nel riconoscimento, nello sviluppo e nell'equità.

Supporto flotta e coordinamento centrale

- Servire come principale collegamento aziendale per tutti i servizi F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Coordinate pianificazione delle attrezzature F&B, sourcing dei materiali e integrazione degli standard del marchio.

- Compili e analizza report operativi, riassunti di viaggio e metriche di performance per la leadership aziendale.

- Partecipare a riunioni chiave di bordo da remoto o di persona come richiesto.

Supervisione finanziaria

- Sostenere la sostenibilità finanziaria e la redditività delle operazioni F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Implementare programmi di miglioramento continuo per raggiungere obiettivi operativi e finanziari.

- supervisionare il controllo dei costi, la pianificazione dell'inventario e l'assegnazione delle risorse in coordinamento con i team di bordo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Minimo 15 anni in alta gamma Food & Beverage operazioni.

- Almeno 5 anni in ruoli di leadership senior all'interno di ospitalità di lusso o operazioni di crociera.

- Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione operativa multi-sito.

I tuoi essenziali

Leadership e comunicazione

- Leader strategico e dinamico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene.

Conoscenza tecnica e operativa

- Proficiente in Microsoft Office e sistemi specifici per il settore.

- Forte comprensione dei protocolli HR, dei regolamenti del lavoro e degli standard di conformità.

- Conoscenza esperta delle operazioni F&B, della programmazione delle bevande e degli standard di ospitalità di lusso.

Competenze professionali

- Pensatore strategico con agilità operativa e forte acume aziendale.

- Risultati guidati, orientati ai dettagli e altamente collaborativi.

- Capace di lavorare in modo trasversale in team aziendali e di bordo.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Ziel

Der F&B Service Manager ist eine strategische Hauptsitz-basierte Rolle, die für die Bereitstellung von Führung, Aufsicht und Beratung für alle Food & Beverage Service-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte verantwortlich ist. Diese Rolle sorgt für Service-Exzellenz, Konsistenz im Gasterlebnis und Ausrichtung auf Unternehmensstandards. Als primäre Verbindung zwischen Schifffahrtsteams und Unternehmensführung treibt der Manager von F&B Service Qualität, Innovation, Compliance und Talententwicklung in allen F&B-Operationen an. Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten der F&B.

Ihre Auswirkungen

Strategische Operationen & Standards

- F&B-Service-Standards und bewährte Praktiken definieren, umsetzen und pflegen.

- Entwicklung und Überwachung strategischer Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Gasterfahrung und betrieblicher Effizienz in allen Schiffen.

- Koordination mit Shipboard-Teams, um die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, Verfahren und Markenstandards zu gewährleisten.

- Durchführung von Fernaudits, operativen Bewertungen und Bewertungen, um Service-Exzellenz zu erhalten.

Gasterlebnis und Qualitätssicherung

- Überwachen Sie die Gästezufriedenheit und die F&B-Leistungsmetriken, analysieren Sie Trends und empfehlen Verbesserungen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit kulinarischen und Getränke-Teams, um das an Bord der F&B-Angebote zu innovieren und zu erhöhen.

- Stellen Sie durch unternehmensgeführte Programme die Ausrichtung auf globale Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokolle sicher.

Ausbildung und Führung

- Entwerfen und überwachen Sie Trainingsprogramme für F&B-Teams, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Dienstleistungsphilosophie der Marke zu gewährleisten.

- Mentor und entwickeln die F&B-Führungskräfte der Schifffahrt, um den beruflichen Fortschritt und die Nachfolgeplanung zu unterstützen.

Personal- und Führungsaufsicht

- Zusammenarbeit mit HR über Leistungsbewertungen, Promotionen, Rotationen und Karrierewege für F&B-Personal.

- Förderung einer leistungsfähigen Kultur, die in Anerkennung, Entwicklung und Fairness verwurzelt ist.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Koordination

- Führen Sie als wichtigste Unternehmensverbindung für alle F&B-Dienste in der gesamten Flotte.

- Koordinierte F&B-Ausrüstungsplanung, Materialbeschaffung und Integration von Markenstandards.

- Kompilieren und analysieren Sie operative Berichte, Reisezusammenstände und Leistungsmetriken für die Unternehmensführung.

- Beteiligen Sie sich bei den wichtigsten Schifffahrtssitzungen fern oder persönlich nach Bedarf.

Finanzaufsicht

- Unterstützung der finanziellen Nachhaltigkeit und Rentabilität der F&B-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte.

- Durchführung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprogramme zur Erreichung operativer und finanzieller Ziele.

- Kostenkontrolle, Inventarplanung und Ressourcenzuweisung in Abstimmung mit Shipboard-Teams.

Ihre Reise so weit

- Mindestens 15 Jahre im High-End-Food & Beverage-Betrieb.

- Mindestens 5 Jahre in leitenden Führungsrollen innerhalb der Gastfreundschaft oder Kreuzfahrten.

- Erfahrungen in der Multi-Site-Betriebsaufsicht.

Ihre Essenzen

Führung und Kommunikation

- Strategischer, dynamischer Führer mit Erfahrung, multikulturelle Teams zu verwalten.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, fließend in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Vermögen.

Technisches und operatives Wissen

- Proficient in Microsoft Office und branchenspezifischen Systemen.

- Starkes Verständnis von HR-Protokollen, Arbeitsvorschriften und Compliance-Standards.

- Expertenwissen über F&B-Operationen, Getränkeprogrammierung und luxuriöse Gastfreundschaft Standards.

Berufliche Kompetenzen

- Strategischer Denker mit operativer Agilität und starkem Geschäft.

- Ergebnisgetrieben, detailorientiert und sehr kollaborativ.

- Ermöglicht die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Firmen- und Schiffsteams.

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Votre but

Le gestionnaire des services F&B est un responsable stratégique de l'administration centrale qui assure le leadership, la surveillance et l'orientation de toutes les activités des services d'alimentation et de boissons dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Ce rôle assure l'excellence du service, l'uniformité de l'expérience des invités et l'harmonisation avec les normes ministérielles. En tant que principale liaison entre les équipes de bord et le leadership de l'entreprise, le gestionnaire du Service F&B favorise la qualité, l'innovation, la conformité et le développement des talents dans toutes les opérations de F&B. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président de F&B.

Votre impact

Opérations stratégiques et normes

- Définir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des normes de service et des pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle de la flotte.

- Élaborer et superviser des initiatives stratégiques pour améliorer l'expérience des invités et l'efficacité opérationnelle de tous les navires.

- Coordonner avec les équipes de bord pour assurer le respect des politiques, des procédures et des normes de marque.

- Effectuer des vérifications à distance, des examens opérationnels et des évaluations pour maintenir l'excellence du service.

Expérience des invités et assurance qualité

- Surveiller la satisfaction des clients et les mesures du rendement des F et B, analyser les tendances et recommander des améliorations.

- Collaborer avec des équipes culinaires et de boissons pour innover et élever l'offre de F&B à bord.

- Assurer l'harmonisation avec les protocoles mondiaux de santé, de sécurité et d'hygiène au moyen de programmes dirigés par l'entreprise.

Formation et perfectionnement en leadership

- Concevoir et superviser des programmes de formation pour les équipes F&B afin d'assurer la cohérence avec la philosophie de service de la marque.

- Mentor et former des chefs de F&B à bord des navires pour appuyer l'avancement professionnel et la planification de la relève.

Surveillance des ressources humaines et du leadership

- Collaborer avec les RH aux examens du rendement, aux promotions, aux rotations et à l'orientation de carrière du personnel des F&B.

- Promouvoir une culture de haute performance ancrée dans la reconnaissance, le développement et l'équité.

Soutien de la flotte et coordination du quartier général

- Servir de principale liaison ministérielle pour toutes les questions relatives aux services F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Coordonner la planification de l'équipement F&B, l'approvisionnement en matériel et l'intégration des normes de marque.

- Compiler et analyser les rapports opérationnels, les résumés de voyage et les indicateurs de rendement pour le leadership ministériel.

- Participer à des réunions clés à distance ou en personne au besoin.

Contrôle financier

- Soutenir la viabilité financière et la rentabilité des activités de F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'amélioration continue pour atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et financiers.

- Surveiller le contrôle des coûts, la planification des stocks et l'affectation des ressources en coordination avec les équipes de bord.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Au moins 15 ans dans les exploitations haut de gamme d'aliments et de boissons.

- Au moins 5 ans à des postes de direction dans l'hôtellerie de luxe ou les opérations de croisière.

- Expérience éprouvée en matière de surveillance opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites.

Vos essentiels

Leadership et communication

- Leader stratégique et dynamique avec expérience en gestion d'équipes multiculturelles.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, maîtrise de l'anglais; langues supplémentaires un atout.

Connaissances techniques et opérationnelles

- Compétence en Microsoft Office et systèmes spécifiques à l'industrie.

- Une bonne compréhension des protocoles RH, des règlements du travail et des normes de conformité.

- Connaissances spécialisées des opérations de F&B, de la programmation des boissons et des normes d'accueil de luxe.

Compétence professionnelle

- Un penseur stratégique avec une agilité opérationnelle et un sens des affaires.

- Des résultats axés sur les détails et une collaboration étroite.

- Capable de travailler de manière interfonctionnelle entre les équipes d'entreprise et de bord.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Culinary Leadership

- Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy.

- Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices.

- Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs.

- Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects.

Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance

- Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required.

- Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels.

- Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements.

- Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols.

- Oversee beverage order and loading coordination.

Training & Leadership Development

- Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs.

- Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards.

- Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions.

Human Resources & Team Management

- Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness.

- Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing.

- Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet.

- Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership.

Financial Oversight

- Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management.

- Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department.

- Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning.

- Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems.

- Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations.

- Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and guest experience-focused.

- Strong collaborator capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Essendo il collegamento strategico tra l'ufficio aziendale di Ginevra e i team di viaggio e di bordo, questo ruolo garantisce una qualità costante, il rispetto degli standard aziendali e la continua innovazione culinaria. Questo ruolo riporta direttamente al Vice Presidente della F&B. Il tuo impatto Leadership culinaria strategica - Fornire leadership visionaria e guida per il team culinario di tutta la flotta, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia del marchio. - Definire, implementare e sostenere gli standard operativi e le migliori pratiche culinarie a livello della flotta. - Gioca un ruolo attivo nella pianificazione strategica per tutte le esigenze di servizio e bevande F&B. - Sviluppo del menu di piombo, creazione di ricette e realizzazione di progetti culinari. Supervisione operativa e garanzia di qualità - Condurre le revisioni operative strutturate, gli audit remoti e le visite delle navi come richiesto. - Assicurare la qualità, la presentazione e la consistenza degli alimenti in tutte le navi. - Monitorare le metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e implementare miglioramenti strategici. - Assicurare il rispetto dei protocolli globali di salute, sicurezza e igiene. - supervisionare l'ordine delle bevande e il coordinamento del carico. Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership - Mentore e sviluppare futuri leader culinari e chef a bordo. - Progettare e implementare programmi di formazione a livello di flotta in linea con gli standard di marca. - Promuovere la pianificazione di successione a lungo termine per le posizioni di leadership culinaria. Risorse umane e gestione del team - Guidare una cultura ad alte prestazioni enfatizzando il riconoscimento, lo sviluppo e l'equità. - Superare le recensioni delle prestazioni di leadership, le promozioni e il percorso di carriera. - Supporto HR in reclutamento per posizioni culinarie senior e rotazione host. Supporto flotta e coordinamento centrale - Agire come principale collegamento per tutte le questioni culinarie tra il quartier generale aziendale e la flotta. - Coordinate la pianificazione delle attrezzature galley, il sourcing dei materiali e l'integrazione degli standard del marchio. - Compili rapporti operativi e finanziari per la leadership aziendale. Supervisione finanziaria - supervisionare gli ordini alimentari e mantenere l'elenco dei master alimentari per garantire accuratezza, pianificazione corretta dell'ordine e gestione delle sequenze. - Responsabile del costo finanziario complessivo del reparto culinario. - Implementare piani di miglioramento continuo per soddisfare o superare obiettivi economici. - supervisionare il controllo dei costi, l'ottimizzazione dell'inventario e la pianificazione delle risorse. - Gioca un ruolo chiave per il costo finanziario complessivo del dipartimento culinario. Il tuo viaggio finora - Minimo 15 anni in operazioni culinarie di fascia alta con competenze avanzate. - Almeno 5 anni in ruoli di leadership senior all'interno di ospitalità di lusso o operazioni di crociera. - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione culinaria a livello di flotta o multi-sito. I tuoi essenziali Leadership e comunicazione - Leader dinamico e strategico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene. Conoscenza tecnica e operativa - Proficiente in Microsoft Office Suite e sistemi specifici per il settore. - La conoscenza dei protocolli HR, la conformità del tempo e della frequenza e le normative del lavoro. - Competenza nelle operazioni culinarie, nello sviluppo dei menu e negli standard di ospitalità di lusso. Competenze professionali - Pensatore strategico con agilità operativa e forte acume aziendale. - Altamente orientata ai dettagli, orientata ai risultati e orientata all'esperienza degli ospiti. - Forte collaboratore in grado di lavorare trasversalmente in team aziendali e di bordo. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Culinary Operations Manager bietet strategische Führung und Aufsicht für alle kulinarischen Operationen in der gesamten Flotte. Der Manager von Culinary Operations ist eine strategische Rolle für die Gesamtfinanzkosten der kulinarischen Abteilung, Überwachung und Führung des Teams und aktiv an der Rekrutierung von Führungspositionen innerhalb der kulinarischen Funktion. Als strategische Verbindung zwischen dem Firmensitz in Genf und den Reise- und Schifffahrtsteams sorgt diese Rolle für gleichbleibende Qualität, Einhaltung von Unternehmensstandards und kontinuierliche kulinarische Innovation. Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten der F&B. Ihre Auswirkungen Strategische Kulinarische Führung - Bereiten Sie visionäre Führung und Führung für das kulinarische Team über die gesamte Flotte, um eine Ausrichtung auf die Markenphilosophie zu gewährleisten. - Definieren, implementieren und aufrecht erhalten flottenweite kulinarische operative Standards und beste Praktiken. - Spielen Sie eine aktive Rolle in der strategischen Planung für alle F&B-Service und Getränkebedarf. - Lead-Menü-Entwicklung, Rezept-Erstellung und Umsetzung von kulinarischen Projekten. Betriebsaufsicht und Qualitätssicherung - Durchführung von strukturierten operativen Bewertungen, Remote Audits und Schiffsbesuchen nach Bedarf. - Sicherstellung der Lebensmittelqualität, Präsentation und Konsistenz auf allen Schiffen. - Überwachen Sie die Zufriedenheit der Gäste und implementieren Sie strategische Verbesserungen. - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von globalen Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokollen. - Beaufsichtigen Sie den Getränkeauftrag und laden Sie die Koordination. Ausbildung und Führung - Mentor und entwickeln zukünftige kulinarische Führer und an Bord Köche. - Entwerfen und implementieren Sie flottenweite Trainingsprogramme im Einklang mit Markenstandards. - Langfristige Nachfolgeplanung für kulinarische Führungspositionen. Personal- und Teammanagement - Fahren Sie eine leistungsfähige Kultur, die Anerkennung, Entwicklung und Fairness betont. - Beaufsichtigen Sie Führungsleistungen, Promotionen und Karriereweg. - Personal bei der Rekrutierung von hochrangigen kulinarischen Positionen und Host-Rotationen unterstützen. Fleet Support & Headquarters Koordination - Act als Hauptverbindung für alle kulinarischen Angelegenheiten zwischen Firmensitz und Flotte. - Koordinierte Gerstenausrüstungsplanung, Materialbeschaffung und Integration von Markenstandards. - Kompilieren Sie operative und finanzielle Berichte für die Unternehmensführung. Finanzaufsicht - Überwachung von Lebensmittelaufträgen und Aufrechterhaltung der Lebensmittel-Masterliste, um Genauigkeit, ordnungsgemäße Auftragsplanung und Sequenzmanagement zu gewährleisten. - Verantwortlich für die Gesamtkosten der kulinarischen Abteilung. - Durchführung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsplänen zur Erfüllung oder Überschreitung wirtschaftlicher Ziele. - Kostenkontrolle, Bestandsoptimierung und Ressourcenplanung. - Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle für die Gesamtkosten der kulinarischen Abteilung. Ihre Reise so weit - Mindestens 15 Jahre in gehobenen kulinarischen Operationen mit fortgeschrittenen Fähigkeiten. - Mindestens 5 Jahre in leitenden Führungsrollen innerhalb der Gastfreundschaft oder Kreuzfahrten. - Bewährte Erfahrung im flottenweiten oder multi-site kulinarischen Management. Ihre Essenzen Führung und Kommunikation - Dynamischer, strategischer Führer mit Erfahrung, multikulturelle Teams zu verwalten. - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, fließend in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Vermögen. Technisches und operatives Wissen - Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite und branchenspezifischen Systemen. - Wissen über HR-Protokolle, Zeit- und Teilnahmebedingungen und Arbeitsvorschriften. - Expertise in kulinarischen Betrieben, Menüentwicklung und luxuriösen Gastfreundschaft Standards. Berufliche Kompetenzen - Strategischer Denker mit operativer Agilität und starkem Geschäft. - Sehr detailorientierte, ergebnisorientierte und erlebnisorientierte Gäste. - Starker Mitarbeiter, der in der Lage ist, quer über Unternehmens- und Schiffsteams zu arbeiten. Unser Engagement Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le gestionnaire des opérations culinaires assure le leadership stratégique et la surveillance de toutes les opérations culinaires de la flotte. Le gestionnaire des opérations culinaires joue un rôle stratégique en ce qui concerne le coût financier global du service culinaire, surveille et guide l'équipe et participe activement au recrutement pour des postes de leadership au sein de la fonction culinaire. En tant que lien stratégique entre le bureau de l'entreprise à Genève et les équipes de voyage et de bord, ce rôle assure une qualité cohérente, le respect des normes de l'entreprise et l'innovation culinaire continue. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président de F&B. Votre impact Leadership culinaire stratégique - Fournir un leadership visionnaire et des conseils à l'équipe culinaire de toute la flotte, en assurant l'alignement avec la philosophie de la marque. - Définir, mettre en œuvre et respecter les normes et les meilleures pratiques d'exploitation culinaire à l'échelle de la flotte. - Jouer un rôle actif dans la planification stratégique pour tous les besoins en services et boissons F&B. - Développement de menus de plomb, création de recettes et réalisation de projets culinaires. Surveillance opérationnelle et assurance de la qualité - Effectuer des examens opérationnels structurés, des vérifications à distance et des visites de navires au besoin. - Assurer la qualité, la présentation et la cohérence des aliments dans tous les vaisseaux. - Surveiller les indicateurs de satisfaction des clients et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations stratégiques. - Assurer le respect des protocoles mondiaux de santé, de sécurité et d'hygiène. - Surveiller l'ordre des boissons et la coordination du chargement. Formation et perfectionnement en leadership - Mentor et développer de futurs chefs culinaires et chefs embarqués. - Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de formation à l'échelle de la flotte conformément aux normes de la marque. - Favoriser la planification à long terme de la relève pour les postes de direction culinaire. Ressources humaines et gestion d'équipe - Conduire une culture de haute performance mettant l'accent sur la reconnaissance, le développement et l'équité. - Surveiller les examens de rendement en leadership, les promotions et le cheminement de carrière. - Soutenir les ressources humaines dans le recrutement de postes culinaires de haut niveau et la rotation des hôtes. Soutien de la flotte et coordination du quartier général - Agir comme principale liaison pour toutes les questions culinaires entre le siège social et la flotte. - Coordonner la planification des équipements de cuisine, l'approvisionnement en matériaux et l'intégration des normes de marque. - Compiler des rapports opérationnels et financiers pour le leadership de l'entreprise. Contrôle financier - Surveiller les commandes d'aliments et tenir la liste des aliments maîtres pour assurer l'exactitude, la bonne planification des commandes et la gestion des séquences. - Responsable du coût financier global du service culinaire. - Mettre en œuvre des plans d'amélioration continue pour atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs économiques. - Superviser le contrôle des coûts, l'optimisation des stocks et la planification des ressources. - Jouer un rôle clé pour le coût financier global du département culinaire. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - Au moins 15 ans dans des opérations culinaires haut de gamme avec des compétences avancées. - Au moins 5 ans à des postes de direction dans l'hôtellerie de luxe ou les opérations de croisière. - Expérience éprouvée en gestion culinaire à l'échelle de la flotte ou de plusieurs sites. Vos essentiels Leadership et communication - Leader dynamique et stratégique avec expérience dans la gestion d'équipes multiculturelles. - Excellentes compétences en communication, maîtrise de l'anglais; langues supplémentaires un atout. Connaissances techniques et opérationnelles - Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite et systèmes spécifiques à l'industrie. - Connaissance des protocoles de RH, du temps et de la fréquentation, et des règlements du travail. - Expertise en opérations culinaires, développement de menus et normes d'hospitalité de luxe. Compétence professionnelle - Un penseur stratégique avec une agilité opérationnelle et un sens des affaires. - Très axé sur les détails, les résultats et l'expérience des invités. - Collaborateur fort capable de travailler interfonctionnellement entre les équipes d'entreprise et de bord. Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Direct-to-Consumer Channels Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.
